summary.text: Danny Nix Jr. represents District 75 in the Florida House of Representatives as a Republican, elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Nix lives in Port Charlotte, works as a commercial realtor, and holds the Certified Commercial Investment Member (CCIM) designation.
Nix was born in Athens, Georgia, moved to Florida in 2011, and holds an A.A. from Keiser University and a B.S. in marketing from Western Governors University.
